grammar.title: 语法知识 短语动词
lines: 5 let vt. 允许，让
let off 免除 (任务或义务) I realized that having a new baby lets you off going to boring dinner parties. 我意识到，生了个孩子你就可以 不参加 无聊的宴会了。
宽恕，放过（犯错误或违法的人） As he has a good record, we shall let him off this time.
引爆，释放（压力等） We always let off fireworks. 我们总是会放烟花。
let down 失望或辜负 I expected him to help me, but he let me down . I was really let down by his broken promise.
放松或减弱 She let down her hair and relaxed after a long day at work.
放下或降低 He let down the ladder for the firefighters to climb up.
使下降 Please let down the curtain .请把窗帘放下来。
let sb. in 允许（空气、光线、水等）进入 If anyone knocks at the door when I am out,don' t let him in .
使某人或某事陷入不利的境地 His careless actions let him in for a world of trouble with his boss. (他的粗心行为使他陷入了与老板的一系列麻烦之中。)
与某人分享信息或允许其参与 It depends on how full the class is and how many additional students the professor is willing to let in . 这取决于课堂有多满，以及教授愿意让多少额外的学生 加入 。
let out 结束；放学；放假 After the long meeting, the chairman finally let out a sigh of relief. (长时间的会议结束后，主席终于 松了 口气。)
放出去 Who let the dog out .
agree vi. 同意（计划、建议等），常与 to 和 with 连用 accept vt. 接受，收受
They invited me to their wedding and I’ve agreed to go. I don’t agree with your opinion. She offered me some of her children’s clothes and I accepted them. I don’t accept your opinion.
dress vt.&vt. 穿衣，打扮 dress up 穿上盛装，精心打扮，装扮（成…）
Tom has nearly learned how to dress himself now. He dressed up as Father Christmas.
原型 (Base Form) 过去式 (Past Tense) 过去分词 (Past Participle) 现在分词
let let/letted let/letted letting
ride rode ridden riding
come c a me come coming

sentences.title: 单词句型 情态动词汇总
lines: 7 每日习语 Actions speak louder than words 行胜于言，事实胜于雄辩
Can (ability) 能力 I can speak English. 我能说英语。
Should (advice) 建议 You should work hard. 你应该努力工作。
Need to (requirement) 必要要求 You need to work hard. 你需要努力工作。
Could (politeness) 礼貌请求 Could you help me? 你能帮帮我吗？
Will (future) 将来 I will call you later. 我待会儿给你打电话。
Dare (courage) 勇气 He didn't dare speak. 他不敢说话。
May (permission) 许可 May I come in? 我可以进来吗？
Would (politeness) 礼貌 Would you like tea? 你想喝茶吗？
Used to (past habit) 过去习惯 I used to play football. 我过去常踢足球。
Might (possibility) 可能性 It might rain. 可能会下雨。
Must (necessity) 必要性 You must hurry. 你必须快点。
Have to (obligation) 义务 I have to go now. 我现在得走了。
Shall (offer) 提议 Shall we go there? 我们要去那里吗？
Ought to (advice) 建议 You ought to rest. 你应该休息。
Had better (strong advice) 强烈建议 You had better sleep early. 你最好早点睡觉。
